title: Successor control for recording stages
statement: Given a natural number $k$, types $Q,T,S$, a Boolean-symbol multi-tape Turing machine $M$ with $k$ work tapes, start and finish states in $S$, a record-step index, and decidable equality on $S$, define a partial successor function from the phase associated with that index to an optional next index-phase pair. The successor is determined by the stage and phase cases: completed scans and sweeps advance through the recording procedure, update the stored data when required, and may select a verdict; the seek and restore stages continue only at the specified finish state, and phases not matching a case have no successor.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean-symbol multi-tape machine $M$ with $k$ work tapes
A phase associated with the index
caveat: The definition is an extensive transition table; this summary describes its overall structure but does not enumerate every stage-specific transition.
